verdict.rationale: Make's own help docs say users can transform and format data using its range of functions, which covers the transformation part of the story. The evidence is a single thin line, and nothing explicitly documents mapping outputs from one module to the next or describes the expression or formula syntax. Missing for 10: documented data mapping between scenario steps, details of the function or formula library and its syntax, independent or hands-on corroboration.
